# Claude Code release manifest (real)

`manifest-2.1.319.json` and its detached signature `manifest-2.1.319.json.sig`, downloaded unchanged on 2026-11-08 from
`https://downloads.claude.ai/claude-code-releases/2.1.319/manifest.json(.sig)`. They check the OpenPGP verifier and
`ClaudeCodeDistribution` against Anthropic's real release key (embedded in the app, `src/AiLocalPack.Agents/Claude/Files`).
Line endings must stay as they are (`.gitattributes`: `-text`), or the signature no longer matches.
